relations.evidence: For Couchbase Server 6.0 and earlier, the plan is cached by the SDK (up to a limit of 5000), as well as the Query Service. On Couchbase Server 6.5 and newer, the plan is stored by the Query Service — up to an adjustable limit of 16 384 plans per Query node.

cross_component_finding: The strongest case in the whole batch for the round's hypothesis that concept-docs describes the SAME underlying things as howtos/server: every single substantive concept on this page - prepared statements, CREATE/BUILD INDEX, covering indexes, sequential scan, scan_consistency, query_context - already exists as a promoted n1ql:* or index:* concept, most already at high recurrence from server/'s own statement-reference pages. I minted nothing new for this page at all; the only ids used that are not server-side promoted concepts are the two SDK-glue ids round 3 already minted (sdk:query-options, sdk:scope-level-query) and the already-promoted sdk:query-index-manager. This directly supports reusing rather than duplicating when a concept-docs page is fundamentally re-explaining a server-side mechanism through the SDK's own code examples, rather than introducing a genuinely new SDK-specific distinction.
cross_product_finding: This page's 'Query without Index' paragraph is verbatim-identical (word for word, down to the same three sentences) to querying-your-data.md's own 'Query without Index' section, also in this batch - the same content has been duplicated across two concept-docs pages in the same product tree rather than one page linking to the other.
